_compact_note: Dataset-text fields (input, metadata.prompt, metadata.test) stripped for redistribution -- see DATASET_LICENSE.md. The full manifest (with dataset text) stays local-only; see ARTIFACT_INDEX.md for its path and checksum.

task_selection.rule: task_ids common to all 3 splits (original/oneoff/conflicting) at the pinned HF revision, sorted lexicographically, excluding lcbhard_0/lcbhard_1 (earlier pilots' case-study tasks), first 3 taken. No task was chosen or dropped based on observed scores or behavior.

known_issues_and_fixes.issue: GPT-5 (via OpenRouter -> Azure/OpenAI backends) rejects Inspect's text_editor tool schema with a 400: OpenAI's strict function-calling mode requires `required` to list every key in `properties`; text_editor's optional args (file_text, insert_line, etc. -- each only meaningful for specific commands) violate that when strict=True.
known_issues_and_fixes.fix: model_args={'strict_tools': False} for GPT-5 only. OpenAICompatibleAPI.__init__'s strict_tools param (default True) controls this; OpenRouterAPI forwards **model_args to it. Confirmed locally that this changes only the request's strict flag -- the tool's actual JSON schema, available commands, and argument semantics are byte-identical either way. Haiku is unaffected (no model_args passed for it). The 2 pre-fix GPT-5 failures (lcbhard_10 original/oneoff) are in run_log below, cost $0 each (confirmed via OpenRouter per-generation records -- rejected before any generation was created), and are NOT counted among the 18 experimental outcomes.

A 21st attempted sample (conflicting/Haiku, pre-fix, killed mid-flight while diagnosing the GPT-5 issue) is not in run_log at all -- 0 samples were ever flushed to its log file, so there is nothing to record beyond its existence (see results/evidence_index.json).
